title: Slice 6 — Reliability (stale/offline/backoff/persistence/security) — docs/plans/magic-mirror/04-slices.md
acceptance: When a source fails (simulated), that section is marked STALE and the last-good data is retained
Unit tests cover exponential backoff with jitter and Retry-After honoring
The last-good JSON is persisted to disk, and on restart the section is restored from last-good before the first refresh (tested)
Responses include security headers: CSP, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy (verified via curl -I)
Secrets do not appear in API JSON or logs (verified by test/grep)
